## FR-12: Persist corrections as executable skill contracts @feature12

When a user correction exposes a repeatable workflow failure, the system SHALL amend the responsible canonical skill with a fail-fast invariant and SHALL add an executable BDD scenario that reads that skill and proves the invariant is present. Recommendation research SHALL treat explicit budget, region, availability, deadline, condition, and include/exclude limits as hard eligibility gates before deep research. Model/provider research SHALL require the real consumer's provider, endpoint/protocol, model-ID namespace, credential sources, persistence boundary, and multi-credential precedence before claiming model unavailability.
